<strand/>Threadling Kills can now spawn a <strand/>Tangle, and reduce Tangle cooldown by 1 second per kill.

Shooting a <strand/>Tangle creates a delayed explosion that detonates after ? seconds, <strand/>Suspending all enemies hit for 7 seconds.

Thrown <strand/>Tangles are unaffected by gravity and aggressively seek targets, attaching to them and detonating after ? seconds. These detonations <strand/>Suspend enemies in a ? meter radius for 7 seconds.
